packs.label: College towns
packs.description: Find 40 college towns from their universities. Harvard and MIT share Cambridge; famous major-city campuses are omitted.

packs.label: Civil War battlefields
packs.description: Famous Civil War battlefields, shown as representative dots within NPS battlefield study areas.

packs.label: National parks
packs.description: All 63 national parks, using NPS legislative boundary polygons. New River Gorge includes its jointly designated preserve.

packs.label: Sports towns
packs.description: Locate the home city associated with a major NFL, NBA, MLB or NHL team. Dots mark city centers, rather than stadiums in neighboring municipalities.

packs.label: Revolutionary battlefields
packs.description: Major American Revolutionary War battlefields, including grouped Lexington–Concord and Saratoga sites.

packs.label: Presidential birthplaces
packs.description: Birthplaces of all 45 individual US presidents through October 2026. Both Adams presidents share one Quincy dot; repeat presidencies appear once.
